backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor that combines authorization and blob-storage mixins, manages user profiles with role-based access control, and handles event registrations (workshop/competition/seminar) with admin-only retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the Register page Fee Breakdown was updated to show a two-line base registration description ('₹149 × 1 member' plus 'Includes 1 Technical & 1 Non-Technical Event') without altering fee logic or other styling.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference for the current state and recent changes of all frontend components and pages.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind base/components/utilities and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell titled 'ELECTROSPARKS' with a root div and a module script tag that bootstraps the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that controls the intro → app phase transition using sessionStorage, configures TanStack Router with all page routes, and wraps the app in QueryClientProvider and RegistrationProvider.
frontend/src/components/CircuitPattern.t: Decorative SVG component that renders a tiled circuit-board pattern (lines, IC chip outlines, dots) in orange tones as an absolutely positioned, pointer-events-none overlay with configurable opacity.
frontend/src/components/CountdownTimer.t: Self-contained countdown timer component that counts down to March 10, 2026 23:59:59, updating every second and displaying Days/Hours/Minutes/Seconds with orange neon glow styling in a glassmorphism container.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with a brand section, quick navigation links, and coordinator contact info, styled with a black/gold/orange theme using inline styles.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Displays an animated loading screen with a canvas-drawn waveform, a progress bar, and cycling status messages that completes after ~3 seconds and calls onComplete.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with desktop links and a mobile hamburger menu, highlighting the active route and applying scroll-based background opacity changes.
frontend/src/components/PhoenixIntro.tsx: Full-screen cinematic intro overlay featuring a phoenix image, animated ember particle canvas effect, and a radial glow pulse that fades out after ~7 seconds before calling onComplete.
frontend/src/contexts/RegistrationContex: Provides a React context for storing, updating, and clearing event registration form data (participant info, event type, amount) across the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook that manage DFINITY AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout state, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a `useSubmitRegistration` React Query mutation hook that calls the backend actor's `submitRegistration` method and invalidates the 'registrations' query cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for a dark neon-cyan theme, and provides utility classes for neon text, borders, and glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in TanStack QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying staff and student coordinator details with names and phone numbers, styled with an orange neon/glass-card aesthetic and a circuit background pattern.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing/home page for the VibECX event featuring a hero section with animated title, college branding, and a stats bar showing prize pool, colleges, participants, and event counts.
frontend/src/pages/NonTechnicalEvents.ts: Page listing five non-technical events (AD-MAD, JAM, Dump Charades, Talent Show, E-Sports) in a responsive grid with orange-themed cards and hover effects.
frontend/src/pages/Payment.tsx: Payment page that displays a QR code amount loaded from localStorage, accepts a screenshot upload via drag-and-drop or file picker, and submits the full registration to the backend actor on confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/Register.tsx: Registration form page that collects participant details, calculates fees based on member count and event type, and navigates to the payment page while persisting data via RegistrationContext and localStorage.
frontend/src/pages/Schedule.tsx: Displays a filterable day schedule for VibECX-2K26 with events categorized as technical, non-technical, or general, each showing time, duration, venue, and description.
frontend/src/pages/Success.tsx: Static success page shown after registration completion, confirming submission and informing the user that a payment verification email will be sent.
frontend/src/pages/TechnicalEvents.tsx: Displays a grid of five technical events (Paper Presentation, PCB Design, Technical Crosscode, Tech Talk, Quiz Master) with icons, descriptions, and hover effects.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, store, retrieve, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the theme with custom fonts (Orbitron, Share Tech Mono, Rajdhani), neon color palette using oklch, neon box-shadow utilities, and animation keyframes. Includes plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing an event registration app feature request to update the Fee Breakdown section's Base Registration description to display two lines ('₹149 × 1 member' and 'Includes 1 Technical & 1 Non-Technical Event') without altering fees or layout.
